text:
Anika: Heads up — flying into the coastal offsite Wed night (arrive ~11:40pm). Heard the hotel lobby can get a bit soggy after heavy rain. Any soggy-boot survival tips? Also open to sharing a taxi/ride from the airport.
Marcos: Pack a small roll-up shoe bag (silicone ones) + a pair of fast-dry wool socks. Ask the front desk for a drying rack — they usually have one in housekeeping.
Jess: :thumbsup: I also bring a cheap pair of foldable waterproof shoe covers for rainy walks. Pro tip: toss a few silica packets or hotel coffee packs in shoes overnight to pull moisture.
Sam: If you want to share a ride, I'm on the 12:05am shuttle. @Anika want me to grab you at arrivals?
Anika: Thanks! @Sam that would be amazing if you're not out of your way. Also — anyone have one of those battery shoe-dryers I can borrow?
Jess: I have a tiny battery shoe-dryer, will bring it. It's bulky but works.
Marcos: If you're worried about the room smelling damp, line shoes with a thin plastic bag and keep them on the balcony/near AC, not on carpet.
TripBot: Flight DL723: departure delayed 25m — updated ETA 12:05am (auto-alert).
Anika: Ugh timing, thanks @TripBot. Okay @Sam I'll aim for the 12:30am pickup then.
Jess: Quick poll: boots vs sneakers for the offsite? Boots = :boot: , Sneakers = :athletic_shoe:
Marcos: Boots for the hikes, sneakers for the sessions. Personally bringing both.
Sam: Boots. Waterproof.
Anika: Boots + foldable backup sneakers in carry-on. Also big thanks @Jess for the dryer.
Jess: No prob! I'll label it so it doesn't wander off. See y'all there — bring a spare pair of socks. :socks:
